assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable book-cover ornamental illustration for a historical library. Create one FLAT portrait 2:3 cover design: thin precise WHITE engraved lines on PURE BLACK (#000000), inspired by Italian Renaissance printed book ornaments, circa 1500–1700. A fine double rectangular frame, restrained symmetrical acanthus vines at the corners, small graceful classical rosette at bottom. Broad open central black space from 18% to 80% height and 18% to 82% width, reserved for title and author typeset later. No letters, no numbers, no words, no logo, no publisher marks, no heraldic arms. Balanced, scholarly, elegant, delicate but readable linework at thumbnail size. Entire artwork is white linework and black negative space only. No gradients, no gold, no textures, no physical book, no perspective, no shadow. This is an explicitly imagined period-inspired cover, not a facsimile. Fill the full portrait canvas with the black design.
